messages:
Morgan: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — three remediation items we need owners for: 1) missing spans in the frontend tracer, 2) bad aggregation in the hourly rollup, 3) recurring ETL lag spikes. Suggesting owners and a short timeline below.

Devon: I can take the ETL lag spikes. I dug into the job logs, looks like backpressure + one worker OOMing on nodepool-2. Need a short PoC to change the retry/backoff and add memory headroom. ETA 2 sprints? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Sasha: I'll own the aggregation bug. I have a hypothesis: boundary condition in the merge step when window crosses DST results in double-counting for some keys. Will add guarded checks and unit tests. ETA 1 week for patch + e2e.

Kai: I can look at the missing spans. Might be a sampling config regression from the rollout last week. I'll coordinate with SDK owners and add a canary that forces 100% sampling in staging to reproduce. ETA 3 days to confirm, 1 week for fix.

Morgan: Nice — can we put these into a lightweight cadence so we don't lose momentum? Proposed: weekly 30m sync (Thu 10am) for 4 weeks, and a shared checklist. If any fix is >2w we escalate to the stability board.

Sasha: SGTM. I'll create the checklist doc and include the failing prompt sets used by Optimize. Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/agg-drift-checklist (will post PR when ready).

Devon: For ETL I'll try a quick mitigation first: bump worker memory to 64GB and add an early fail metric to surface OOMs before downstream lag, then do the retry tuning. I'll add the runbook snippet here.

PagerBot: [alert] Job etl-hourly-runner failed 3x in last 24h on nodepool-2 due to OOM. See: https://monitoring.redwood/services/etl-hourly-runner/incidents/5678

Devon: Runbook snippet I'll add to the checklist:
```
- When lag > 15m: check nodepool-2 OOMs via k8s events
- If OOMs present: spin up temporary nodepool-2-hot (1 node, 64GB), scale etl-hourly-runner to 3 replicas
- If lag persists: escalate to infra oncall and enable 2x retries with exponential backoff
```

Kai: For tracing, here's the quick repro I used in staging: force-sample header + trace-level env var. Attaching command:
```bash
curl -H "X-Force-Sample: 1" https://staging-app.internal/healthcheck
```
That surfaced the missing spans — looks like the SDK drops spans when payloads exceed 128KB. I'll instrument a small fix to stream big payloads instead of bundling.

Morgan: Great detail. Action items:
- Sasha: aggregation patch + tests, PR by EOD Fri (owner: Sasha)
- Kai: tracing repro + fix, canary in staging by next Tue (owner: Kai)
- Devon: ETL mitigation + runbook entry, temporary autoscale change today, follow-up plan by next Wed (owner: Devon)
- Morgan: schedule weekly syncs and circulate checklist (owner: Morgan)

Sasha: Will do. Adding unit/regression test cases that cover DST boundary and empty-window slices.

Devon: Pushed a temp nodepool scale and runbook to the checklist. Noted metrics to watch: etl.lag, etl.worker.oom_count, queue.backlog.

Kai: After the SDK fix I'll run a 24h canary and share traces. If >0 missing spans remain we will roll back the rollout from last week.

Morgan: If any of you hit blockers ping me and I'll pull in infra or platform. Thanks all — I'll create the calendar invite and checklist doc now. :thumbsup:

PagerBot: [task] Created doc: https://docs.redwood/internal/postmortems/1755559999-remediation-checklist

Sasha: Added initial PR: https://git.redwood/internal/agg-fix/pulls/42 — tests failing on mock timezone, debugging now.

Devon: Noted. I'll add the incident label and link this thread to the postmortem for traceability.

Kai: Awesome. Closing loop — will report progress in Thu sync.
